title: Some of the nation’s rich are letting AI teach their kids
brief: Wealthy families in Silicon Valley are enrolling their children in AI-powered private schools like Forge Prep and Alpha School, paying tens of thousands of dollars for AI tutoring and interactive workshops despite broader public skepticism about AI reliability. The trend reflects a growing divide between affluent early adopters willing to use their children as beta testers for AI education tools and mainstream consumer distrust of AI applications.
